title: cross-team-engineering-leadership-weekly-staff-notes-2026-03-23
body:
Attendees: Ava Chen, Ethan Patel, Maya Thompson, Ravi Singh, Sofia Martinez, Jonah Lee, Priya Kapoor
Apologies: Marco Diaz

Agenda:
- Quick updates from subteams (serving runtime, infra, observability, private deployments)
- Capacity & Dedicated pool forecast for next quarter
- Incident post-mortem follow-up: 2026-03-18 SLO breach (KV cache thrash)
- Rollout plan for v2.4 kernel selection changes
- Open blockers / escalations
- AOB

Notes / Updates:
1) Serving-runtime (Ethan)
- v2.4 kernel selection landed in staging, initial perf looks +12% p95 for chat workloads. Still seeing a small tail on long-seq tails (>4096) when combined with quantized kernels.
- Working hypothesis: suboptimal kernel path for split-attention in mixed-quant paths. Ethan to add more tracing hooks next week.
- Perf test caveat: our internal chat benchmark uses cached prefixes aggressively; need a follow-up run with cold-cache profile to estimate cold-start p95.
- Rollout plan: canary 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 2 weeks with automatic rollback threshold at +3% p95 regression.

2) Private deployments (Maya)
- One pilot customer on v1.18 private package; found a networking edge-case with KMS calls behind customer firewall. Patch ready, waiting on customer test window.
- Packaging: improved installer logs to include KMS handshake details. Should reduce debug time.

3) Infrastructure (Ravi)
- Dedicated pool capacity plan: GA demand forecast increased by 18% month-over-month; need to open procurement request for 8 more A100 nodes for June.
- Autoscale tune: observed thrash at 60-75% utilization due to overly-aggressive downscale. Proposed change: increase cooldown to 10m and min-capacity hold for 15m after scale-in event.

4) Observability & Console (Sofia)
- Trace sampling experiment: moving from 5% uniform to adaptive sampling based on latency spikes. Early results show improved signal for tail latency events with same ingest cost.
- Cost dashboard: adding per-model quantization view to help customers see token-cost delta. Target: beta in console by end of April.

Incident follow-up (2026-03-18 SLO breach):
- Root cause: KV cache thrash triggered by a rare multi-region routing scenario + simultaneous model-variant fallback. Cache invalidation executed inefficiently, causing hot reloads and increased token compute.
- Immediate mitigations implemented: serialized invalidation for affected keys + temporary route pinning for high-traffic tenants.
- TODOs from PM: add unit/integration test that simulates multi-variant fallback + KV invalidation sequence. (Owner: Priya, due 2026-04-06)

Decisions:
- Proceed with v2.4 canary rollout with stricter rollback thresholds for long-seq profiles. (Decision owner: Ava)
- Approve increased cooldown for autoscaler (Ravi to implement).

Open Blockers / Risks:
- Long-seq tail behavior on mixed-quant paths (Ethan) - high priority. Need deeper profiling (perf flamegraphs + per-op timing) by 2026-03-30.
- Procurement lead time for Dedicated GPUs may push capacity availability into late-June if PO delayed. Finance to prioritize.
- Private deployment KMS edge-case: waiting on customer test window; if they delay, pilot timelines slip.

Action Items (owner / due):
- Ethan: add additional tracing hooks around kernel selection and mixed-quant paths; produce perf flamegraphs for long-seq cases. Due 2026-03-30.
- Priya: create integration test for multi-variant fallback + KV invalidation; add to CI. Due 2026-04-06.
- Ravi: implement autoscaler cooldown changes and run soak test (staging). Due 2026-03-29.
- Maya: coordinate with pilot customer and schedule KMS test window; report status. Due 2026-03-27.
- Sofia: prototype quantization cost view in console; share mockups with PM. Due 2026-04-02.
- Ava: finalize canary rollout doc and publish to Confluence. Due 2026-03-24.

Notes to self / loose threads:
- Need follow-up on evaluation harness to include cold-cache chat workloads. Add to perf backlog.
- Consider short-term mitigations for long-seq tails: fallback to scalar attention path for sequences > 8192 until kernel path is optimized. Tradeoff: higher cost for reduced tail latency spikes.
- Revisit SLO alerting thresholds for multi-region tenants; current thresholds mask region-specific degradations.

AOB:
- Next week: coordinate with product-hosted-api for feature flag gating of kernel selection per-tenant.
- Reminder: leadership offsite planning doc (shared) - RSVP by end of week.

Meeting adjourned 11:05am PST

Draft notes — will tidy and push canonical copy to Confluence after action items synchronized.
